Day two will address sub-aerial threats, blue economy security, information warfare and bio-security frameworks.

title: Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN) and PHARMEXCIL Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Boost Legitimate Pharmaceutical Exports and Strengthen Regulatory Cooperation
summary: The Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN), under the Department of Revenue, and PHARMEXCIL (Pharmaceuticals Export Promotion Council of India, under the Commerce Ministry) signed an MoU at CBN Headquarters in Gwalior to promote legitimate pharmaceutical exports while strengthening regulatory oversight against diversion of controlled substances. The MoU introduces a voluntary, non-binding Code of Conduct, trade facilitation measures, capacity-building workshops, and an information-sharing framework, with a six-month action plan for implementation.

title: National Conclave on Tribal Languages & Museums begins in Mysuru, Karnataka
summary: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs began a three-day National Conclave on Tribal Languages & Museums in Mysuru, Karnataka, bringing together linguists, technologists and tribal representatives to discuss documentation of tribal languages and strengthening Tribal Freedom Fighter Museums (TFFM). Key launches included the upgraded 'Adi Vaani' platform (with an iOS app and five new languages), the AI conversational assistant 'Jago' for tribal welfare information, and a Memorandum of Understanding between MoTA and the Central Institute of Indian Languages (CIIL) for language documentation and corpus development. Karnataka also released new tribal-language primers, including a Jenukuruba Class 1 primer. The conclave will conclude on 25 August 2026 with the adoption of the 'Mysuru Declaration' and sessions on TFFMs.

title: Chirag Paswan inaugurates PMFME Bazaar showcasing India’s Diverse Micro Food Enterprises
summary: On 24 August 2026, Union Minister Chirag Paswan inaugurated the PMFME Conclave 2026 and its associated PMFME Bazaar at India Habitat Centre, New Delhi, featuring exhibitors from 25 States/UTs showcasing traditional and processed food products under the PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme. The two-day event also saw the launch of a coffee table book of beneficiary success stories, a new quarterly magazine 'FoodNova', and MoUs with APEDA, ONDC and NABKISAN to boost market and institutional linkages for micro food enterprises. The Minister called for a more comprehensive 'PMFME 2.0' to address evolving needs of the sector.

title: Regional Manthan Conference on Road Safety
summary: MoRTH's Supreme Court Committee on Road Safety, chaired by Justice A M Sapre, held a Regional Manthan Conference in Mumbai for Maharashtra, Gujarat, Goa and DNH & DD to review road safety initiatives. The conference discussed the Zero Fatality District (ZFD) initiative covering 100 high-fatality districts, the PM Rahat cashless treatment scheme, the Rah-Veer Good Samaritan award scheme, the Sadak Suraksha Mitra youth volunteer programme, and the Data-Driven Hyperlocal Intervention (DDHI) framework. States were asked to prepare District Road Safety Plans to help India achieve its goal of reducing road fatalities by 50% by 2030.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: India Post Accelerates Digital and Infrastructure Transformation with Upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa Apps
summary: The Department of Posts launched upgraded Dak MITRA and Dak Sewa mobile applications and inaugurated 14 renovated Post Office buildings across India on 24 August 2026. Dak MITRA, developed by CEPT, is a unified digital platform for over 1.4 lakh Branch Post Offices enabling paperless doorstep transactions including banking, insurance and Aadhaar-based e-KYC, while Dak Sewa offers citizens 24x7 access to postal services in 23 languages via BHASHINI. The renovation drive, guided by an SPA-designed Design Manual, has modernised 27 of 40 pilot Post Offices, with plans to extend it to 60 more offices this financial year.

title: RBI's USD-INR Swap Facility Sparks Unprecedented Forex Inflows into India, Banks Raise USD 73 Billion in eleven weeks
summary: The RBI's special USD-INR forex swap facility for FCNR(B) deposits, OFCB and ECBs, launched on June 8, 2026, mobilized US$73 billion in foreign exchange inflows by August 21, 2026, with FCNR(B) deposits alone contributing US$65.40 billion. This pace has exceeded the RBI's 2013 FCNR(B) swap scheme (which raised about US$26 billion over three months), prompting the RBI to advance closure of the FCNR(B) window from September 30 to August 31, 2026.

title: ENVOYS OF SIX NATIONS PRESENT CREDENTIALS TO THE PRESIDENT OF INDIA
summary: President Droupadi Murmu accepted credentials from six new envoys at Rashtrapati Bhavan on 24 August 2026, representing South Sudan, the United Arab Emirates, Nigeria, Moldova, Germany and Sweden. The ceremony formally recognizes these diplomats as accredited ambassadors/high commissioners to India.

title: Union Minister for Chemicals and Fertilizers chairs CEO Roundtable to discuss priorities to transform India into a Global Chemical Manufacturing and Innovation hub

ministry.name: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers :Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals

summary: The Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals, with Invest India, held a CEO Roundtable on 24 August 2026 chaired by Union Minister J.P. Nadda to discuss India's goal of building a USD 1 trillion chemicals sector by 2040. Over 100 delegates from more than 30 global and Indian chemical companies (BASF, Reliance, Dow, UPL, SABIC and others) raised issues such as investment financing, upgrading PCPIRs into major hubs, trade remedial measures, R&D incentives, single-window clearances, and a National Feedstock Policy. Union Minister Anupriya Patel highlighted existing reforms like Bhavya Rasayan, Coal Gasification, Rare Earth Corridors and the Critical Mineral Mission, while state governments (Odisha, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh) presented investment incentive packages.

title: All India: Progressive Crop Area Sown Report - Kharif Weekly area coverage as on 2026-08-21
summary: The Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare released the Kharif crop sowing progress report as on 21 August 2026, showing a total sown area of 1056.70 lakh ha, down 16.07 lakh ha from 1072.77 lakh ha in the corresponding week of 2025-26. Rice, coarse cereals, oilseeds, sugarcane and cotton acreage declined marginally, while total pulses and jute & mesta area increased. State-wise variations were noted, with Karnataka, Maharashtra and Telangana showing notable declines in rice and coarse cereals, and Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan and Chhattisgarh showing gains in pulses and coarse cereals.

title: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal addresses Japanese Business Federation in Tokyo
summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal led India's largest-ever business delegation (200+ representatives) to Japan from 24-27 August 2026, visiting Tokyo, Nagoya and Osaka under the India-Japan Special Strategic and Global Partnership. In Tokyo, he addressed the Keidanren business federation, called for Japanese companies operating in India to double this decade, held meetings with major firms including Sumitomo, Mitsubishi, Tokyo Electron and MinebeaMitsumi on semiconductor and manufacturing investment, and met Japan's National Security Secretariat chief. 2026 has been designated the 'India-Japan Year of Shared Horizons' marking 75 years of diplomatic relations.

title: IFS Officer Trainees of 2025 Batch call on PM
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met 50 Officer Trainees of the 2025 batch of the Indian Foreign Service at Seva Teerth. He urged them to build grassroots engagement in their countries of posting, act as catalysts for India's economic diplomacy, strengthen the digital presence of Indian Missions, and promote India as a global tourism destination using its civilisational and cultural strengths.

title: From Unpaid Helper to Sanitation Entrepreneur: How NAMASTE-SUY Support Transformed Kapil’s Life
summary: A PIB release profiles Kapil, a 25-year-old Scheduled Caste sanitation worker from Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, who used support under the NAMASTE-Swachhta Udyami Yojana (SUY) to buy a tractor-mounted suction machine in 2023. Against a project cost of ₹10,70,400, he received a loan of ₹6,77,800 and a capital subsidy of ₹3,92,600, enabling him to shift from unpaid family labour to running an independent mechanised sanitation enterprise earning ₹30,000-35,000 per month.

title: From Financial Dependence to Self-Employment: Suji K.P.’s Journey of Empowerment
summary: This PIB release profiles Suji K.P., a woman from Wayanad, Kerala, who used a ₹3,00,000 loan under the NBCFDC Self-Employment Scheme in 2023 to set up a tailoring unit after being rejected by conventional banks. She later diversified into photocopying and lamination services and now earns about ₹15,000 per month, achieving financial independence from her husband's income.

title: From Financial Constraints to PhD Completion: How NFSC Support Strengthened Shubhankar Ghorai’s Academic Journey
summary: This PIB release narrates the success story of Shubhankar Ghorai, a scholar from Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal, who completed his Ph.D. with support from the National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC) Scheme. He began receiving fellowship assistance, including House Rent Allowance and contingency support, from February 2020, which helped him overcome financial constraints during his research.

title: Chairman of the Railway Board Reviews IRCTC War Room; Directs Strengthening of Passenger Feedback and Kitchen Monitoring Systems to Improve the Quality of Catering Services
summary: The Chairman of the Railway Board, Satish Kumar, reviewed the IRCTC War Room, directing improvements to passenger feedback systems, kitchen monitoring, and catering quality assurance. Key directives include automating the Rail Madad complaint interface, adding more cameras (including PTZ cameras) for kitchen surveillance, reviewing roti/paratha preparation processes, and ensuring AI-based deficiency alerts (rodents, cockroaches) lead to deterrent action against non-compliant vendors and inspection agencies.

title: Students are the future of the largest democracy in the world: CEC Gyanesh Kumar
summary: The Election Commission of India held its second regional conference on "Electoral Literacy Clubs (ELC 2.0) and ECINET" in Lucknow, addressing students and teachers from schools and colleges across Uttar Pradesh. Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar emphasised that students are the future of democracy and highlighted ELC 2.0's tagline "Learn Democracy. Lead Democracy." as a digitally-enabled initiative leveraging the ECINET platform to spread electoral literacy across India's vast educational network of roughly 15 lakh schools and 1,500 universities.

title: The Fifth Space – Where Education Meets Responsibility
summary: Union Minister Dr. Virendra Kumar interacted with school students at an event titled 'The Fifth Space – Where Education Meets Responsibility', organised by the National Commission for Women with DAIC, UNESCO New Delhi and Mount Abu Public School. He spoke about digital responsibility, emotional connection between students, parents and teachers, and the concept of a 'Fifth Space' where home, school, culture and the digital world converge. Speakers including NCPCR and NCW officials also discussed child rights, safety and gender equality.

title: Mauritius Minister of Public Service and Administrative Reforms, Lutchmanah Raj Pentiah, calls on Minister Dr Jitendra Singh; discusses further strengthening of India-Mauritius cooperation in public service, training and capacity building

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: Mauritius's Minister of Public Service and Administrative Reforms, Lutchmanah Raj Pentiah, met Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh in Delhi to discuss deepening India-Mauritius cooperation in public service training and capacity building. Discussions covered the ongoing NCGG programme to train 500 Mauritian civil servants over five years, stronger institutional linkages between Mauritius's ABVIPSI and Indian institutions like LBSNAA, IIPA and ISTM, and expanding the iGOT Karmayogi Mauritius digital learning platform. Both sides also explored cooperation in Blue Economy, ocean technologies, fisheries and desalination.

title: CHEMCONNECT 2026: Industry-Academia Event will be held Tomorrow at IIT, MADRAS

ministry.name: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers :Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals

summary: CHEMCONNECT 2026, a one-day industry-academia event, is being held at IIT Madras, jointly organized by the Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals (DCPC) and IIT Madras to showcase technologies, prototypes and patents from 18 Centres of Excellence (CoEs) set up under DCPC's CoE scheme. Principal Investigators will exhibit their work to industry representatives, start-ups, MSMEs, investors and policymakers to facilitate licensing, technology transfer and commercialization.

title: Third Meeting of India-Cambodia Joint Working Group on Trade and Investment (JWGTI) Held in Phnom Penh, Cambodia
summary: India and Cambodia held the Third Joint Working Group on Trade and Investment (JWGTI) meeting in Phnom Penh on 24 August 2026, co-chaired by Joint Secretary Amit Verma and Cambodia's Director General Long Kemvichet. Bilateral trade grew over 36% to USD 406.78 million in 2025-26, with further 63.25% growth in Q1 2026-27. The two sides discussed a Customs Cooperation MoU, a Bilateral Investment Treaty, UPI-KHQR payment linkage expansion, and cooperation in pharmaceuticals, agriculture, and banking.

title: Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India
summary: UPSC has released Special Advertisement No. 52/2026 inviting applications for direct recruitment to various posts in the Government of India. Eligible candidates can apply online through the Online Recruitment Application (ORA) portal between 22nd August and 11th September, 2026. Detailed instructions and vacancy information are available on the UPSC website.

title: “Khelo India Dialogue – Khel Ki Baat, PM Modi Ke Saath” to be Organised Nationwide on 27th August 2026 to celebrate National Sports Day

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

summary: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports announced a nationwide event, "Khelo India Dialogue – Khel Ki Baat, Pradhan Mantri Modi Ke Saath," to be held on 27 August 2026 to mark National Sports Day, involving over 1,500 educational institutions. PM Narendra Modi will give a virtual address to young athletes, followed by interactions involving prominent sportspersons, MPs, MLAs and ministers around four themes including grassroots sports infrastructure, 2036 Olympics preparation, youth leadership, and future-ready skills. The event also includes a quiz and encourages registration on the MY Bharat Portal for sustained youth engagement.

title: President of India Smt Droupadi Murmu to Confer National Awards to Teachers on 21 teachers/faculties of HEIs and Polytechnics on Teachers Day 2026
summary: The President of India will confer National Awards to Teachers (NAT) 2026 on 21 teachers/faculty members from Higher Education Institutions and polytechnics at a ceremony in New Delhi on September 5, 2026. Awardees include 12 from central HEIs, five from state universities (three government, two private colleges), and four from polytechnics (two government, two private). Nominations were invited online via the Rashtriya Puraskar Portal between May 26 and July 20, 2026, with selection based on teaching effectiveness, research, outreach, and other parameters through a two-stage screening and jury process.

title: Union Minister for Finance & Corporate Affairs Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman will embark on official visit to Canada and USA from 25th August to 2nd September 2026
summary: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman will visit Canada and the USA from 25 August to 2 September 2026, covering Toronto, Chicago, Asheville and New York. Key engagements include the inaugural India-Canada Economic and Financial Dialogue, investment and business roundtables with CEOs, diaspora interactions, and leading India's delegation at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors (FMCBG) meeting under the US G20 Presidency.

title: India restored 21.76 mn ha Land during 2011–2020, generating 1.22 bn person-days of Employment: Shri Bhupender Yadav at UNCCD COP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: At UNCCD COP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav stated that India restored 21.76 million hectares of degraded land between 2011-2020, generating about 1.22 billion person-days of employment, as per India's Second Progress Report on the Bonn Challenge. India had pledged to restore 26 million hectares by 2030 under the Bonn Challenge, enhanced from its 2015 commitment. The Minister outlined India's multi-sectoral approach including the Green India Mission, Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), and Nagar Van Yojana, and announced the next reporting cycle for 2021-2025 in collaboration with ICFRE and IUCN.

title: Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Proposes Amendments to Medical Devices Rules, 2017 to Promote Ease of Doing Business

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

summary: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has amended the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 to ease regulatory compliance for manufacturers. Rule 44 has been changed so manufacturers outsourcing sterilization to a validly licensed facility no longer need a separate loan licence, with a six-month transition period for new labelling requirements. Rule 63 has been amended to add the European Union to the list of recognized stringent regulatory jurisdictions (alongside the US, UK, Australia, Canada, and Japan) whose approvals allow a waiver of clinical investigation requirements for medical devices without predicate devices.

title: UPI: Transforming India's Payment Landscape
summary: This PIB backgrounder traces the decade-long evolution of India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI), from its 2016 launch by NPCI to its current status as a global leader in real-time payments. It highlights key milestones (UPI 2.0, AutoPay, 123PAY, Lite, Credit Line on UPI), growth statistics (transaction volume rising from 2 crore to over 24,162 crore annually, transaction value from ₹0.07 lakh crore to ~₹314 lakh crore), and international expansion to 11 countries including recent additions Greece and the Maldives. It also notes an IMF report crediting UPI with ~49% of global real-time payment transaction volume in 2024.

title: Vice-President launches India’s first non-GMO high-expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed in Andhra Pradesh
summary: Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan launched India's first non-GMO, high-expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed, developed by the company Gourmet Popcornica, at Musunuru in Eluru district, Andhra Pradesh. He called it a step towards Aatmanirbhar Bharat in agriculture, noting India's past dependence on imported hybrid seed technology for popcorn maize. He also felicitated farmers and partners, highlighting that over 17,500 farmers across eight states, cultivating nearly 40,000 acres, are linked to this enterprise.

title: AIIA Launches “GARBHINI MITRA” Course to Strengthen Ayurveda-Based Maternal Wellness Support
summary: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), New Delhi has launched a new six-month skill-development course called 'Garbhini Mitra' for the 2026-27 academic session, aimed at training personnel to provide Ayurveda-based lifestyle guidance and community support to women during pregnancy and the postnatal period. The course, based on classical concepts of Garbhini Paricharya, Sutika Paricharya and Garbhadhana Vidhi, admits 20 students per batch who have passed Class 12, with applications closing on August 31, 2026. Graduates can work as Garbhini Mitra Assistants or Antenatal/Postnatal Wellness Guides in Ayush centres, clinics and NGOs, supplementing but not replacing clinical antenatal care.

title: UPI Completes 10 Years of Digital Payments Revolution- Globally Recognised as World’s Largest Real‑Time Payment System
summary: The Unified Payments Interface (UPI), launched by NPCI on 25 August 2016 under RBI's oversight, has completed 10 years of operation. Annual transaction volume grew nearly 13,000-fold from 1.78 crore (FY 2016-17) to over 24,162 crore (FY 2025-26), while transaction value rose about 4,000-fold to around ₹314 lakh crore. The IMF has recognised UPI as the world's largest real-time payment system, accounting for nearly 49% of global real-time payment volume, and it is now operational in 11 countries.

title: Prize Distribution Function of the 58thYouth Parliament Competition, 2025-26 for schools under the Directorate of Education, Government of NCT of Delhi, and the Department of Education, NDMC
summary: The Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs will hold the Prize Distribution Function of the 58th Youth Parliament Competition 2025-26 for Delhi schools on 25 August 2026 at Parliament House Complex, presided over by Minister of State Arjun Ram Meghwal. Bal Bharti Public School, Pitampura won first place and the GV Mavalankar Running Parliamentary Shield, with 11 other schools receiving merit trophies.

title: Minister of State for Commerce and Industry and Electronics & Information Technology Shri Jitin Prasada on Official Visit to Morocco
summary: Minister of State for Commerce and Industry Jitin Prasada visited Morocco on 24-25 August 2026 to co-chair the 7th India-Morocco Joint Commission with Moroccan counterpart Omar Hejira. The visit covered trade diversification, market access, and cooperation in areas like fertilizers, industry, agriculture and digital transformation, and included plans to sign MoUs on food safety (FSSAI-ONSSA) and a 2026-2030 Cultural Exchange Programme. Bilateral merchandise trade stood at about USD 4 billion in 2025, with India exporting refined petroleum and pharmaceuticals, and Morocco supplying phosphates and fertilizers to India.

title: India calls for Diversified, Adequate, Predictable and Sustained International Finance for Land Restoration and Drought Resilience at UNCCD CoP17, at Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: At the UNCCD CoP17 in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia, Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav called for diversified, adequate, predictable and sustained international finance for land restoration and drought resilience. He showcased India's blended green-finance framework, including Sovereign Green Bonds, the Green Credit Programme, and the compensatory afforestation/conservation regime, as models for mobilising public-private finance for degraded land restoration.

title: PROVISIONAL ESTIMATES OF SERVICE PRODUCER PRICE INDICES (BASE YEAR 2022-23)  FOR Q1 OF FY 2026-27 AND FINAL INDICES FOR Q4 OF FY 2025-26
summary: The Ministry of Commerce & Industry released provisional Service Producer Price Indices (PPI) for Q1 FY 2026-27 and final indices for Q4 FY 2025-26, covering seven services: securities transactions, banking, pension fund management, insurance, telecom, railways, and air passenger services (Base Year 2022-23). Notable movements include a sharp rise in the Air (Passenger) Service Price Index to 126.4 (31.94% YoY inflation) and an increase in the Pension Fund Management index to 113.3 (5.2% YoY). The next release, covering Q2 FY 2026-27, is scheduled for 25 November 2026.

title: GENESIS Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR) Cohort-3 Launched at GENESIS NextGen Startup Summit - Coimbatore Edition
summary: MeitY Startup Hub has launched Cohort-3 of the GENESIS Entrepreneur-in-Residence (EIR) programme, opening applications from 4 August to 3 September 2026 for early-stage innovators in Tier-II/III cities. Selected applicants working on Electronics, IT, ICT and DeepTech ideas (TRL 1-4) can receive up to ₹10 lakh in funding along with mentorship and incubation support through participating GENESIS incubators. The cohort was launched at the GENESIS NextGen Startup Summit in Coimbatore.

title: Indian Railways Launches a Special Drive for Cleaning and Disinfection of Drinking Water Tanks and Filters
summary: Indian Railways has launched a special drive across all Zonal Railways to clean and disinfect drinking-water tanks, filters, coolers and vending machines at stations. The drive includes comprehensive inspection, draining, desludging and disinfection of tanks, checks on hand pumps/borewells, UV/RO purification systems, and residual-chlorine monitoring, with station-wise deficiency reporting and corrective action tracking.

title: NA-Allocated Talabira II & III Coal Mines Mark Record Production in FY 2025-26
summary: The Ministry of Coal highlighted record performance at the Talabira II & III Open Cast Coal Mine in Odisha, allocated to NLC India Ltd. in 2016 under the Coal Mines (Special Provisions) Act, 2015. In FY 2025-26 the mine achieved its highest-ever annual production of 19.14 MT (up 11.28% year-on-year) and highest-ever dispatch of 17.69 MT, alongside strong safety, technology adoption, environmental and CSR outcomes.

title: Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Proposes Amendments to Medical Devices Rules, 2017 to Promote Ease of Doing Business

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

summary: The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has proposed amendments to the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 to promote Ease of Doing Business by simplifying regulations in three areas: manufacturers using outsourced sterilization facilities no longer need a separate loan licence under Rule 25 if the sterilization facility itself is licensed; a new Ninth Schedule prescribes uniform testing fees across Medical Device Testing Laboratories; and the European Union has been added under Rule 63 to the list of recognized stringent regulatory jurisdictions (alongside the USA, UK, Australia, Canada and Japan) for waiver of clinical investigation requirements for devices without predicate devices. These changes aim to reduce compliance costs, timelines and ambiguity while enabling faster market access for medical devices already approved in the EU.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: CBN busts inter-state heroin syndicate in ‘Op Black Hawk’; seizes over 18.6 kg crude heroin
summary: The Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN), through its MP and UP units, conducted 'Operation Black Hawk' near Lucknow, seizing a total of 18.64 kg of crude heroin in two separate interceptions on the Sultanpur-Lucknow highway and near Barabanki. Three suspects were arrested and booked under the NDPS Act, 1985. The heroin, concealed in a fabricated fuel tank cavity and a hidden truck compartment, was being trafficked from a North-Eastern state to Uttar Pradesh.

title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the values of compassion and contentment
summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media platform X, highlighting that compassion brings self-respect while contentment brings true happiness. He noted that this spirit strengthens cooperation and harmony in society, and that laziness and indecisiveness should be overcome through effort and entrepreneurship.

title: INDIAN AIR FORCE CONCLUDES HIGH-TEMPO MULTINATIONAL EXERCISES PITCH BLACK AND UDARA SHAKTI 2026
summary: The Indian Air Force concluded participation in two multinational exercises: Pitch Black 2026 in Australia, hosted by the Royal Australian Air Force with over 20 nations, where IAF Rafale jets conducted Large Force Employment missions; and Udara Shakti 2026 in Subang, Malaysia, a bilateral exercise with the Royal Malaysian Air Force involving combat sorties against Su-30MKM and F/A-18 Hornet aircraft. Both exercises aimed to enhance interoperability, tactical coordination, and strategic defence partnerships across the Indo-Pacific.

title: CSIR-NIScPR Organises Platinum Jubilee Ceremony to Mark 75 years of its popular Hindi science magazine, ‘Vigyan Pragati’
summary: CSIR-NIScPR held a Platinum Jubilee Ceremony in Delhi to mark 75 years of its Hindi science magazine 'Vigyan Pragati', launched in 1952. The event included a student workshop, panel discussions on science communication and AI, release of a special issue and new publications, and felicitation of the magazine's editorial team.

title: Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah undertakes a review of the security of Siliguri corridor
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah reviewed the security of the strategically vital Siliguri Corridor in a meeting attended by central and West Bengal state officials, the Army, BSF, SSB, RPF and West Bengal's Chief Minister. He reviewed infrastructure projects critical to the corridor's security, discussed illegal immigration, demographic change and PIO activities, and directed agencies to adopt a 'quadrangular approach' to border security, remove encroachments, and expand institutional presence in the area.

title: BRICS Youth Ministers’ Meeting 2026 Concludes in Visakhapatnam; Joint Statement Adopted

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

summary: The BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting concluded in Visakhapatnam on 22 August 2026, chaired by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya and MoS Raksha Nikhil Khadse, with BRICS nations adopting a Joint Statement on youth cooperation. The meeting followed the BRICS Youth Summit and BRICS Youth Council Meeting held earlier in Gandhinagar, and covered themes like education, entrepreneurship, science and technology, and youth inclusion. Sideline activities included a plantation drive and a visit to Totlakonda Buddhist Monastery, while Mandaviya also held bilateral talks with counterparts from South Africa and the UAE.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: Lieutenant Governor of Jammu & Kashmir meets Prime Minister
summary: Lieutenant Governor of Jammu & Kashmir Manoj Sinha met Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on 22 August 2026. The Prime Minister's Office announced the meeting via a post on X, with no further details on the agenda or outcomes disclosed.

title: National Workshop on "Mission Zero –  Ending Fatalities in Sanitation Work"
summary: A National Workshop titled 'Mission Zero: Ending Fatalities in Sanitation Work' was held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, bringing together central and state officials, ULBs, technology providers and sanitation workers to discuss mechanisation and safety in sanitation work. Secretary Sudhansh Pant of the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment stated that achieving zero fatalities in sanitation work is a core national priority, calling for a whole-of-government approach. The workshop referenced the NAMASTE and GARIMA schemes as vehicles for mechanisation, occupational safety, health, education and livelihood support for sanitation workers and their dependents.

title: Dr Jitendra Singh announces unanimous adoption of 'Chennai Declaration', reaffirming BRICS commitment to build effective, resilient and future- ready framework in science, technology and innovation
summary: At the closing session of the 14th BRICS Science Ministerial Meet chaired by India in Chennai, Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh announced the unanimous adoption of the 'Chennai Declaration' (Chennai Consensus), reaffirming BRICS commitment to a resilient, people-centred science, technology and innovation (STI) framework. The declaration endorses initiatives like the BRICS Global Research Advanced Infrastructure Network (BRICS GRAIN), a BRICS Science and Research Repository, the Young Scientist Forum, Young Innovator Prize, and a BRICS STI Calendar of Activities for 2026-27, before the chairship passes to China in 2027.

title: MAHESHWARI SAMAJ HAS A GLORIOUS LEGACY OF SERVICE, SACRIFICE AND SOCIAL COMMITMENT: LOK SABHA SPEAKER
summary: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla addressed the foundation-laying ceremony of the Maheshwari Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre in Jaipur, praising the Maheshwari Samaj's historical contributions to education, social service and the freedom movement. He emphasized that nation-building is a shared responsibility of government and society, and called for affordable, accessible and quality healthcare to reach remote areas of the country.

title: A meeting was held in Siliguri today under the Chairmanship of Union Home Minister Shri Amit Shah and in presence of Chief Minister of West Bengal Shri Suvendu Adhikari with different stakeholders and representatives of hill areas of West Bengal
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired a meeting in Siliguri with West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and representatives of hill-area political parties and organisations to discuss long-standing demands of the hill population, including a distinct identity, a Permanent Political Solution, and constitutional recognition. Shah promised a Permanent Political Solution soon within the framework of the Constitution and announced formation of a committee headed by interlocutor Pankaj Kumar Singh (former Deputy NSA) to finalise modalities for a final agreement.

title: India Must Move from ‘Pharmacy of the World’ to ‘Laboratory of the World’; AI Must Complement, not Replace, Human Clinical Judgement : Union Minister Smt. Anupriya Patel

ministry.name: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers :Department of Pharmaceuticals

summary: At the IIM Ahmedabad Healthcare Summit 2026, Union Minister Anupriya Patel called for India to transition from being the 'Pharmacy of the World' to the 'Laboratory of the World' through research-driven, AI-enabled healthcare innovation, while cautioning that AI must complement rather than replace clinical judgement. She highlighted the ₹5,000 crore PRIP Scheme and ₹10,000 crore Biopharma SHAKTI mission, and officials cited ABDM's 96 crore ABHA IDs, over 1,000 crore linked health records, and eSanjeevani's 20 crore beneficiaries. The event also saw the launch of the India Pharma Archives digital repository and a book on India's COVID-19 vaccine journey.

title: National Workshop on “Mission Zero – Ending Fatalities in Sanitation Work”
summary: A National Workshop titled "Mission Zero: Ending Fatalities in Sanitation Work" was held in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, bringing together central and state officials, ULBs, sanitation-sector experts and workers to discuss mechanisation and safety in sanitation work. Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment Secretary Sudhansh Pant stated that the NAMASTE scheme has been extended up to 2031 to ensure systematic sanitation service delivery through Emergency Response Sanitation Units (ERSUs), and highlighted the role of NAMASTE, GARIMA and the 2024 Swachhata Sarthi/waste-picker component in providing safety, health, education and livelihood support to sanitation workers and their dependents.

title: NBA releases ₹2.82 crore of ABS funds to 27 State Biodiversity Boards, 3 UT Biodiversity Councils and ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research, Karnataka

ministry.name: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

summary: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) has disbursed ₹2.82 crore under India's Access and Benefit-Sharing (ABS) mechanism, with ₹2.80 crore going to 27 State Biodiversity Boards and 3 UT Biodiversity Councils, and ₹2.01 lakh to ICAR-Indian Institute of Horticultural Research (IIHR), Karnataka. The funds originated from ABS payments by Advanta Enterprises (for hybrid seed genetic resources) and Sumitomo Chemical India (for two microbial strains sourced from ICAR-IIHR). Gujarat, West Bengal and Madhya Pradesh received the largest shares among states, and the total ABS amount disbursed by NBA to date now stands at ₹185 crore.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Statutory and Regulatory Bodies

title: EPFO urges establishments to utilize the Employees’ Enrolment Campaign, 2026 to ensure social security for employees outside EPF coverage
summary: EPFO has launched the Employees' Enrolment Campaign 2026 (EEC 2026), effective from 29 June 2026 and open till 31 October 2026, giving employers a one-time opportunity to enrol employees who were left out of EPF coverage between 1 April 2009 and 31 March 2026. The campaign offers relaxations such as waiver of the employee's share of contribution where it was not previously deducted, and requires enrolment via a Face Authentication-based UAN generated through UMANG, with contributions remitted through the Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR). EPFO is conducting outreach to employers, PSUs, and government bodies to maximise voluntary compliance and extend provident fund, pension, and insurance benefits to previously uncovered workers.

title: National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP)
summary: The National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP), launched in September 2019, aims to control and eradicate Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) and Brucellosis in Indian livestock through nationwide vaccination and surveillance. It has administered 147.16 crore FMD vaccine doses benefiting 8.04 crore farmers, reducing FMD outbreaks from 132 (2019) to 40 (2025) and Brucellosis outbreaks from 22 to 15 over the same period. The programme has been subsumed, along with other components, into the new umbrella Livestock Health and Disease Control Programme (LHDCP) with a ₹2,010 crore outlay for 2026-27, and is supported by the Bharat Pashudhan Portal, Mobile Veterinary Units, and India's One Health Mission.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: DELIVERY OF MANGROL – THE THIRD ANTI-SUBMARINE WARFARE SHALLOW WATER CRAFT BUILT BY CSL, KOCHI
summary: The Indian Navy received 'Mangrol', the third Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW-SWC) built by Cochin Shipyard Limited, on 21 August 2026. The vessel is over 80% indigenous, waterjet-propelled, and equipped with torpedoes, anti-submarine rockets, radars and sonars for coastal ASW, mine warfare and low-intensity maritime operations. It is named after the port town of Mangrol in Gujarat's Junagadh district, reviving the name of a former INS Mangrol minesweeper retired in 2004.

title: Official Visit of Shri Hardeep Singh Puri, Minister for Petroleum and Natural Gas, to Mauritius
summary: Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri visited Mauritius on 20-21 August 2026, during which India and Mauritius signed a Government-to-Government MoU on oil and gas cooperation and a five-year Sales and Purchase Agreement between IOCL and Mauritius's State Trading Corporation, under which IOCL will meet Mauritius's entire import requirement of petrol, diesel and aviation fuel. This is the first long-term supply agreement by an Indian PSU oil marketing company outside South Asia in recent years. The visit also saw the launch of a Biofuels Country Landscape Policy framework for Mauritius under the India-led Global Biofuels Alliance, and groundbreaking for a bunker marine fuel storage facility by Indian Oil (Mauritius) Ltd.

title: Empowered Committee Reviews Proposals to Accelerate Growth of Women-led Rural Enterprises
summary: The Empowered Committee of the Ministry of Rural Development, chaired by Secretary Rohit Kansal, reviewed proposals under DAY-NRLM's Non-Farm Livelihoods component to scale up women-led rural enterprises. It approved four new Incubator Sub-Scheme proposals for Bihar, Jammu & Kashmir, Uttar Pradesh and Gujarat, partnering with IIT Patna, IIM Jammu, IIM Lucknow and IIT Gandhinagar respectively, to support over 600 high-potential SHG enterprises. The Committee also considered expansion of the Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme (SVEP) in West Bengal and Goa.

title: Government Restricts Manufacture, Sale and Distribution of Fixed Dose Combinations Containing Chlorpheniramine Maleate and Phenylephrine Hydrochloride for Use in Children Below Four Years

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

summary: The Union Health Ministry has extended restrictions to all Fixed Dose Combinations (FDCs) containing Chlorpheniramine Maleate and Phenylephrine Hydrochloride, mandating a label warning that they must not be used in children below four years. This builds on an earlier notification of 15 April 2025 that restricted only certain such FDCs. The move follows recommendations of an Expert Committee and the Drugs Technical Advisory Board (DTAB), and has been issued under Section 26A of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, citing risks to young children and availability of safer alternatives.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Statutory and Regulatory Bodies

title: 14th India-Nepal Joint Working Group Meeting Held in Dehradun
summary: The 14th India-Nepal Joint Working Group (JWG) meeting was held in Dehradun on 20–21 August 2026, led by Joint Secretary Pausumi Basu (India) and Joint Secretary Ananda Kafle (Nepal). Both sides reviewed bilateral cooperation on border management and security, discussing trans-border crime, border infrastructure like Integrated Check Posts, encroachment removal, and boundary pillar maintenance. They agreed to sustain institutional coordination and capacity building, with the next meeting to be held in Nepal.

title: National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA) conducts sixth outreach programmes with focus on small and medium auditors under the theme “Creating a Better Financial Reporting Ecosystem” in Ahmedabad, today
summary: NFRA held its sixth outreach programme, in Ahmedabad, focused on small and medium auditors under the theme 'Creating a Better Financial Reporting Ecosystem'. It was the second such programme conducted jointly with ICAI, following one in Pune in June 2026, and featured technical sessions on audit strategy, risk of material misstatements, and NFRA oversight case studies. Since the initiative began in 2025, over 450 small and medium audit firms have participated.

title: CCI imposes monetary and non-monetary sanctions on Agro Input Dealers Association, Agro Input Welfare Association for indulging in anti-competitive conduct
summary: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) passed an order on 21 August 2026 against the Agro Input Dealers Association (AIDA), Agro Input Welfare Association (AIWA), and two individuals for cartelisation in violation of Section 3(3)(b) read with Section 3(1) of the Competition Act, 2002. The CCI imposed monetary penalties ranging from about Rs. 8,600 to Rs. 4.98 lakh on the associations and named officials, directed them to cease and desist from such conduct, and ordered them to conduct competition compliance training programmes.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Statutory and Regulatory Bodies

title: CCI imposes penalty on Rekha Agencies and SS Marketing for indulging in anti-competitive conduct in respect of Himachal Pradesh Tender 2013 for the procurement of tyres
summary: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) has penalized Rekha Agencies (INR 1,29,901) and SS Marketing (INR 2,13,274) for bid rigging in a 2013 Himachal Pradesh tender for tyre procurement. The CCI found the firms exchanged commercially sensitive price-bid information before submission, violating Section 3(3)(d) read with Section 3(1) of the Competition Act, 2002. An official of Rekha Agencies was also held personally liable under Section 48, while no penalty was imposed on the SS Marketing official due to his demise.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Statutory and Regulatory Bodies

title: Secretary, Department of Rural Department launches ‘National Campaign on Entrepreneurship - II’ to accelerate rural women entrepreneurship
summary: The Ministry of Rural Development launched the 'National Campaign on Entrepreneurship-II' under DAY-NRLM on 21 August 2026 (World Entrepreneurs Day), running for three months to promote rural women's farm and non-farm enterprises and SHG product marketing. The campaign aims to support the goal of creating 6 crore Lakhpati Didis, with targets including training 5 lakh SHG women, formalising 50,000 enterprises, and onboarding 25,000 SHG members on e-commerce platforms. The Secretary also released the first edition of 'Sankalp Shakti', a monthly Rural Enterprise Tech Bulletin focused on Lakhpati Didi empowerment.

title: BRICS Tourism Ministers adopt Jaipur Declaration (Ministers’ Communique)
summary: The BRICS Tourism Ministers' Meeting, held under India's Chairship in Jaipur, concluded with the adoption of the BRICS Tourism Ministers' Communiqué 2026 (Jaipur Declaration). The declaration frames cooperation among BRICS states around four themes—AI in tourism, sustainability, skilling, and seamless travel facilitation—and was adopted by consensus by ministers from nine member states including Brazil, Iran, South Africa, UAE, China, Ethiopia, Indonesia and Russia. India also held bilateral meetings with several member states on the sidelines.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah inaugurates and lays the foundation stones for various projects of  SSB in Siliguri and interacts with the personnel
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah inaugurated and laid foundation stones for Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) projects worth ₹189 crore in Siliguri, West Bengal, including a new Frontier Headquarters, two battalion buildings and a transit camp. He highlighted the strategic importance of the Siliguri Corridor (connecting eight states and bordering Nepal, Bhutan and Bangladesh), the 'One Border, One Force' policy under which SSB guards India's unfenced borders with Nepal and Bhutan, and announced that the West Bengal government has provided 1,139 acres of land to BSF/SSB and given in-principle approval for 560 acres more for corridor security. He also referenced the Delhi-Siliguri high-speed rail corridor approved in the 2026-27 Budget and the Vibrant Villages Programme for border area development.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: NHAI and National Road Safety Board Deliberates on Strengthening Road Safety on National Highways
summary: NHAI and the National Road Safety Board (NRSB) held an institutional meeting at NHAI headquarters to review road safety systems on National Highways, chaired by NRSB Chairman Dr. Nitin R. Gokarn and NHAI Chairman Santosh Kumar Yadav. The discussion covered highway safety engineering, black spot management, emergency response, and technology tools like ATMS and AI-based solutions, and endorsed a 'Safe System approach' with six strategic focus areas. The two bodies agreed to hold periodic structured review meetings going forward.

title: Sarbananda Sonowal Inaugurates ₹427.80 Crore Projects at Paradip Port, Marks 18.5-Metre Deep-Draft Capability

ministry.name: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

summary: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal inaugurated seven infrastructure projects worth ₹427.80 crore at Paradip Port, Odisha, including capital dredging to achieve an 18.5-metre deep draft for Capesize vessels, a new bridge, PNG supply to residential quarters, and an advanced Vessel Traffic Management System. He also witnessed signing of concession agreements worth ₹1,580.36 crore for three mechanisation projects aimed at achieving 100% berth mechanisation by 2030 (up from 80% currently), and planted the port's one-millionth tree under its plantation drive.

title: Government Strengthens Scholarship Delivery through Direct Benefit Transfer for SC and OBC Students
summary: The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment reported that ₹30.81 crore was disbursed to SC and OBC students in East Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh, during 2025–26 under Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarship Schemes via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The funds covered thousands of beneficiaries, with corresponding data noted as combined figures for East Godavari, Eluru and Kakinada districts due to portal limitations.

title: Government Acts to Curb Sugar Price Rise, Ensure Adequate Availability During Festive Season

ministry.name: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution

summary: Sugar prices rose from ₹48.18/kg on 20 July 2026 to ₹55.70/kg on 20 August 2026, driven by lower domestic production (306 LMT against an estimated 343 LMT), festive-season demand, crop disease and waterlogging, and a global sugar deficit rather than ethanol diversion. In response, the Government has imposed a 400-tonne stock limit on dealers, capped bulk consumer holdings at 15 days' consumption from September, ordered joint stock verification against hoarding, allowed duty-free import of 10 LMT raw sugar, and advised early crushing from 15 October 2026 to boost October output.

title: From Financial Hardship to Academic Excellence: How the Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship Supported Dr. Paramananda Naik's Journey in Anthropology
summary: This PIB release is a human-interest profile of Dr. Paramananda Naik, a Scheduled Caste (PANO) scholar who received the Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (UGC-RGNF-SC), getting ₹16,000 per month from 2016 to 2019. The fellowship supported his doctoral studies in Anthropology, and he subsequently became an Assistant Professor at Utkal University, Bhubaneswar. The release presents his story as an example of how fellowship support helps marginalized students overcome financial and social barriers in higher education.

title: From Sanitation Helper to Mechanised Sanitation Entrepreneur: How NAMASTE-SUY Helped Neeraj Build a Safer and Self-Reliant Livelihood
summary: This PIB release profiles Neeraj, a Scheduled Caste sanitation worker from Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, who transitioned from manual helper work to running his own mechanised sanitation enterprise using financial support under the Swachhta Udyami Yojana (SUY) component of the NAMASTE Scheme. In 2023, he received a project package worth ₹11,90,400 (a ₹7,67,800 loan plus ₹4,22,600 capital subsidy) to buy three suction-machine-fitted tractors, raising his monthly income from about ₹8,000 to ₹30,000-40,000.

title: Union Health Ministry Organises Two-Day National Conference of MDOs in collaboration with National Institute of Health and Family Welfare (NIHFW) , Capacity Building Commission (CBC) and Karmayogi Bharat to Strengthen Organisational Capacity for Mission Karmayogi Implementation

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

summary: The Union Health Ministry held a two-day National Conference of Ministry, Department and Organisations (MDOs) on 20-21 August 2026 at NIHFW, New Delhi, in collaboration with NIHFW, Capacity Building Commission and Karmayogi Bharat to strengthen capacity building for Mission Karmayogi implementation. Representatives from 140 DoHFW institutes discussed knowledge sharing, Capacity Building Units, the Annual Capacity Building Plan 2026-27, and felicitated top performers of Sadhana Saptah.

title: India and Brazil sign Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation in Telecommunications and ICTs
summary: India and Brazil signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen bilateral cooperation in telecommunications and ICTs, signed by Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia and Brazilian Minister of Communications Frederico de Siqueira Filho on the sidelines of the BRICS ICT Track Meeting in Pune. The MoU establishes a framework for cooperation in areas including AI, 5G/6G, Open RAN, IoT, LEO satellites, cybersecurity, digital infrastructure, and Digital Public Infrastructure. It aims to promote exchange of best practices and capacity building between the two countries.

title: 29 FDI Investments Worth ₹4,895.65 Crore Reported Under Revised Framework
summary: India's revised FDI framework, notified via Press Note 2 of 2026, has facilitated 29 foreign investments worth ₹4,895.65 crore up to 20 August 2026, spanning sectors like IT, AI, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals and data centres. The investments originated from jurisdictions including Mauritius, the US, South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Luxembourg and the Cayman Islands. The reform allows non-controlling beneficial ownership of up to 10% from Land Bordering Countries (LBCs) to enter via the automatic route without prior government approval, subject to sectoral caps and conditions.

title: Office of Pr. CCA, Delhi celebrates National Senior Citizens Day; Super Senior pensioners felicitated
summary: The Office of Pr. CCA, Delhi (Department of Telecommunications) celebrated National Senior Citizens Day at Sanchar Lekha Bhawan, chaired by CGCA Vandana Gupta, honouring senior and super senior pensioners. The event included felicitation of nonagenarian pensioners (including 99-year-old Parshuram Sharma), a health check-up camp, cyber security and financial safety awareness sessions with SBI, an AYUSH wellness lecture, and a Know Your Pension/Digital Life Certificate camp.

title: DARPG organises 20th National e-Governance Webinar on Government Process Re-engineering for Digital Transformation

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: DARPG held its 20th National e-Governance Webinar on Government Process Re-engineering for Digital Transformation, showcasing two Central Level Award-winning initiatives from the National Awards for e-Governance 2026 — AgriStack (Ministry of Agriculture) and e-Jagriti (Ministry of Consumer Affairs). AgriStack, built on three federated registries (Farmers' Registry, Crop Sown Registry, Geo-referenced Village Maps), has created over 10 crore Farmer IDs and covers 31.36 crore plots across 648 districts. e-Jagriti provides a unified digital platform for consumer dispute resolution across National, State and District Consumer Commissions, integrating online filing, virtual hearings and analytics dashboards.

title: Ken-Betwa Link Project
summary: This PIB backgrounder is an FAQ explaining the Ken-Betwa Link Project (KBLP), India's first river-interlinking project to reach implementation, which will transfer water from the Ken to the Betwa river via the 96.7m Daudhan Dam and a 216.465 km link canal to address chronic water scarcity in the Bundelkhand region of Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh. Costing ₹44,605 crore and scheduled for completion in 2030, it aims to irrigate 10.62 lakh hectares, supply drinking water to about 62 lakh people, and generate 103 MW of hydropower plus 27 MW of solar power. The document also addresses land acquisition, resettlement packages, environmental clearance, and downstream water-flow concerns for the 22 affected villages in Panna and Chhatarpur districts.

title: Union Health Minister Shri JP Nadda Reviews H1N1 Influenza Preparedness; Emphasises Vigilance and Robust Surveillance

ministry.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

summary: Union Health Minister JP Nadda reviewed India's H1N1 Influenza preparedness, with a focus on Delhi, including surveillance data, ILI/SARI trends, hospital capacity, and critical care infrastructure. He urged continued vigilance, robust surveillance, and public awareness on respiratory hygiene, and also called for coordinated efforts against other seasonal diseases like Dengue and Malaria. The meeting followed a July 2026 advisory from the Union Health Secretary to states on strengthening Acute Respiratory Illness preparedness.

title: Quarterly Bulletin of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (QBUSE)
summary: The National Statistics Office released the Quarterly Bulletin of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (QBUSE) for April-June 2026, showing the unincorporated non-agricultural sector grew 9.2% year-on-year to 8.67 crore establishments, with employment rising 6.55% to 13.70 crore workers. The 'Other Services' sub-sector led growth at over 21%, while trade declined. Enterprise registration rose to 42.5%, women's workforce share crossed 30%, and about 80% of establishments now use cashless transactions.

title: NCSK To Celebrate Its Foundation Day On August 23, 2026 SUNDAY; Around 900 Safai Karamcharis Likely To Participate In Annual Programme
summary: The National Commission for Safai Karamcharis (NCSK) will celebrate its 32nd Foundation Day on 23 August 2026 at Mavalankar Auditorium, Delhi, with around 900 Safai Karamcharis and various stakeholders attending. Union Ministers Arjun Ram Meghwal, Ramdas Athawale and B L Verma will attend, and NCSK will launch a Missed-Call Facility Number to register grievances from stakeholders. The event will focus on dignity, welfare, rehabilitation and elimination of manual scavenging through mechanized sanitation.

title: NO CHANGE OF GUARD CEREMONY THIS SATURDAY
summary: The President's Secretariat announced that the weekly Change of Guard Ceremony at the Rashtrapati Bhavan forecourt will not be held on Saturday, 22 August 2026. The cancellation is due to a full rehearsal being conducted for the ceremonial welcome of the visiting Prime Minister of Bangladesh.

title: PM interacts with CEOs and Founders of Space Startups
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with CEOs and founders of 20 Indian space startups at Seva Teerth, covering areas like launch vehicles, satellites, space debris removal, and climate intelligence. The founders shared progress made since the space sector was opened to private participation and highlighted global interest in Indian space technologies. Modi called for wider social applications of space tech, greater collaboration with other sectors and Atal Tinkering Labs, and positioned India's space sector as a potential global hub for talent and investment.

title: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh delivers inaugural address at BRICS Science Ministerial Meet at Chennai
summary: Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh delivered the inaugural address at the 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting in Chennai, held under India's 2026 BRICS Presidency with the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'. He called for collective BRICS efforts to make innovation accessible, affordable, trusted and sustainable, citing frontier technologies like AI, quantum computing and biotechnology. He referenced India's National Quantum Mission, National Supercomputing Mission, BioE3 Policy, and National Geospatial Policy as examples of India's STI approach.

title: India and ADB sign $230 million loan to modernise water supply and sanitation in Chennai
summary: India and the Asian Development Bank (ADB) signed a $230 million loan agreement to fund the Chennai Climate-Resilient Water Security and Sewerage Project, aimed at modernising the city's water supply and sanitation infrastructure. The project will lay over 170 km of water and sewer pipes, upgrade 7 water and 38 sewer pumping stations, and make Chennai the first Indian city to implement a comprehensive ring-main water distribution system. It also includes digital monitoring tools and technology to eliminate hazardous manual sewer inspections.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: DGGI unearths clandestine pan masala and tobacco manufacturing network in Uttar Pradesh; 27 undeclared pouch-packing machines seized, evasion of about ₹185 crore detected
summary: The DGGI's Lucknow Zonal Unit raided six premises in Chitrakoot and Banda districts of Uttar Pradesh, busting a clandestine pan masala, jarda and gutkha manufacturing network. Officers seized 27 undeclared pouch-packing machines, 15.5 lakh pouches of finished goods, and raw materials, detecting tax evasion of about ₹185 crore; the proprietor was arrested and remanded to judicial custody. Since the capacity-based cess/excise regime for this sector began on 1 February 2026, DGGI has booked 27 cases nationwide, detecting ₹668 crore in evasion, seizing 131 machines and arresting 17 persons.

title: BRICS Youth and Sports Ministers’ Meeting to take place in Visakhapatnam on August 22 & 23, 2026

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

summary: India will host the BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting and BRICS Sports Ministers' Meeting in Visakhapatnam on August 22 and 23, 2026, respectively, under India's BRICS Chairship 2026. The meetings, chaired by Union Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya, will bring together ministers and delegations from all 11 BRICS member nations to discuss youth development, sports technology, and sports manufacturing. The events are expected to conclude with the adoption of a BRICS Youth Ministerial Joint Declaration and Cooperation Framework, and a separate BRICS Sports Joint Declaration.

title: INDIAN ARMY’S TERRITORIAL ARMY LAUNCHES ‘TERRIER CYBER QUEST 2026’
summary: The Indian Army's Territorial Army, partnering with CyberPeace, has launched 'Terrier Cyber Quest 2026' (TCQ 3.0), a national hackathon focused on defence, cybersecurity and information-domain challenges. The third edition features three tracks - Bug Hunting, AI Kavach, and Creators Challenge - open to academia, industry, research institutions and armed forces personnel. Registrations close 31 August 2026, with the Grand Finale in New Delhi from 6-8 October 2026 and award ceremony on 9 October 2026.

title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the spirit of selfless service and dedication
summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media that likens the ceaseless flow of rivers to selfless human service, emphasizing dedication and benevolence for humanity's welfare. He noted this spirit of selfless service can give a new direction to the nation. The post was made via X (formerly Twitter) on 21 August 2026.

title: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
summary: This PIB backgrounder details Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA), the government's umbrella price-support scheme launched in September 2018, comprising four components: Price Support Scheme, Price Stabilization Fund, Price Deficiency Payment Scheme, and Market Intervention Scheme. It highlights a ₹7,200 crore budget for 2026-27 (up from ₹5,437.99 crore actual in 2024-25), procurement rules including 100% state production coverage for Tur, Urad, and Masur, and digital reforms like e-NAM, Aadhaar-based authentication, and AIF-backed infrastructure. It also cites state-level implementation examples from Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: Prime Minister congratulates H.E. President Hakainde Hichilema on re-election as President of Zambia
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated Hakainde Hichilema on his re-election as President of Zambia. Modi highlighted India's multifaceted partnership with Zambia and expressed a desire to strengthen bilateral ties further. The message was conveyed via a post on X (formerly Twitter).

title: Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh meets Prime Minister
summary: Lieutenant Governor of Ladakh Shri Vinai Kumar Saxena met Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on 20 August 2026. The Prime Minister's Office announced the meeting via a post on X, without disclosing details of the discussion.

title: Digital BRICS Forum and Expo held at Pune; Union Minister of Communications, Shri Jyotiraditya Scindia welcomed the delegations
summary: Ministerial delegations from BRICS member countries gathered in Pune for the Digital BRICS Forum and Expo, a multi-stakeholder platform under India's chairship ahead of the 12th BRICS Communications Ministers' Meeting scheduled for 21 August 2026. Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia welcomed delegates at a cultural programme, while MoS Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani led a ministerial fireside chat themed 'Innovate, Cooperate and Transform for a Resilient Future.' The day featured panel discussions on cybersecurity/child online protection and sustainable digital ecosystems, alongside an expo showcasing BRICS startups and innovation.

title: Chief Minister of Assam meets Prime Minister
summary: The Chief Minister of Assam, Himanta Biswa Sarma, met Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on 20 August 2026. The meeting was announced via a brief social media post from the PMO with no details on the agenda or outcomes.

title: Prime Minister shares an article on India’s BRICS chairship and sustainable development
summary: The Prime Minister shared an article by Union Minister Bhupender Yadav on how India's BRICS chairship promotes sustainable development through people-centric climate action. The article cites focus areas like sustainable lifestyles, afforestation, circular economy and community-based adaptation, alongside India's progress in reducing emissions intensity and expanding non-fossil energy capacity. The PMO amplified this via a social media post on X.

title: PM Chairs Third High-Level Meeting with Secretaries to Government of India
summary: PM Narendra Modi chaired the third in a series of high-level meetings with Secretaries to the Government of India, focusing on Infrastructure and Connectivity, Security and External Affairs, and Governance. He urged officials to overcome departmental silos, treat data as a national asset, use AI with human oversight, strengthen defence industry competitiveness, and pursue port-led development and better manufacturing-export connectivity. Secretaries shared perspectives on sectoral priorities and implementation challenges.

title: Text of Keynote address by Sh. Amit Agrawal, Secretary to the Government of India, Department of Telecommunications, at the Thematic Panel Discussion I: Cybersecurity and Trustworthy ICTs, including Child Online Protection
summary: In a keynote at the Digital BRICS Forum 2026 in Pune, DoT Secretary Amit Agrawal outlined India's three-pillar approach to safe and trustworthy digital enablement: safety-by-design infrastructure (Aadhaar, UPI), legal obligations on data fiduciaries and intermediaries (IT Act 2000, Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023), and citizen grievance redress mechanisms (Grievance Appellate Committee, Data Protection Board). He cited data such as 1.4 billion Aadhaar holders, UPI fraud at 0.02 per million transactions, removal of ~875,000 harmful content pieces by major platforms in a month, and over 10,000 appeals disposed by the Grievance Appellate Committee since 2023. He also noted the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 will come into force in May 2027.
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: Japan’s Defence Minister calls on PM Modi
summary: Japan's Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi called on PM Modi during his official visit to India. The two discussed the momentum in India-Japan defence collaboration, building on PM Modi's July 2026 talks with Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi at the 16th India-Japan Annual Summit. Modi highlighted opportunities for Japanese firms and start-ups to partner with Indian companies in defence co-development and co-production under Make in India.

title: Union Minister of State for Finance Shri Pankaj Chaudhary participated virtually in 21st Award Ceremony of Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Limited (SPMCIL) in New Delhi today
summary: Union Minister of State for Finance Pankaj Chaudhary virtually attended the 21st Award Ceremony of the Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Limited (SPMCIL) in New Delhi, marking two decades since the company's 2006 incorporation. The event recognised individual employees and production units for excellence in productivity, safety, energy conservation, and governance, with the CMD Cup going to Security Paper Mill, Narmadapuram. SPMCIL, a Schedule 'A' CPSE under the Department of Economic Affairs, operates nine units producing currency, coins, passports, and other sovereign products.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah welcomes Union Cabinet’s decision enabling sitting of bench of High Court of Jammu and Kashmir in Ladakh
summary: The Union Cabinet has approved setting up a bench of the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir to sit in Ladakh, a decision welcomed by Union Home Minister Amit Shah as historic. The move aims to improve access to justice for residents of Ladakh's remote areas by reducing the time and distance needed to avail legal services. Shah stated the government remains committed to Ladakh's all-round development and constitutional safeguards.

title: MeitY partners with PhonePe to strengthen PM GatiShakti with granular data intelligence
summary: MeitY signed an MoU with fintech company PhonePe to integrate data from PhonePe PulsePro, an enterprise data intelligence platform, into the PM GatiShakti National Master Plan portal. The tie-up, facilitated with BISAG-N which manages the portal, will give government planners access to granular, hyperlocal transaction-based insights to complement existing datasets for infrastructure and economic planning. MeitY Secretary S. Krishnan and PhonePe's Karthik Raghupathy both welcomed the partnership as supporting data-driven, evidence-based planning.

title: Delhi Master Plan 2047: A Roadmap for Viksit Delhi; Viksit Bharat 2047
summary: Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal unveiled the Delhi Master Plan 2047 (MPD-2047) in the presence of Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and Chief Minister Rekha Gupta. The plan envisages around 40 lakh new affordable housing units, a Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) policy, regularisation of 1,511 unauthorised colonies benefiting about 45 lakh residents, a Land Pooling Policy covering nearly 200 sq km to create 12 lakh homes, and conservation of about 1,500 heritage assets. It also proposes a Unified Metropolitan Transport Authority, restoration of 1,700 hectares of Yamuna floodplain, and development hubs such as Narela (education) and Dwarka (investment gateway).
syllabus_topics: GS Paper 2 - Government Policies and Interventions

title: IndiaAI Mission Organises Workshop on AIKosh to Strengthen India's AI-Ready Data Ecosystem
summary: IndiaAI Mission organised a workshop in New Delhi on AIKosh, the national datasets and models platform, bringing together government, industry, academia and startups to discuss data governance, harmonisation and responsible AI-ready data sharing. Sessions covered lawful data sharing, privacy-preserving use, and sectoral roundtables on health, agriculture and education. Two MoUs were signed - one involving IndiaAI, NeGD and IIIT-Bengaluru's Centre for Digital Public Infrastructure, and another between IndiaAI Mission and EkStep Foundation - to strengthen India's AI and Digital Public Infrastructure ecosystem.

title: CMLRE Unveils Landmark National Report on Deep-Sea and Distant-Water Fishery Resources of the Indian EEZ to Fuel Sustainable Blue Economy
summary: To mark the Silver Jubilee of the Centre for Marine Living Resources & Ecology (CMLRE), the Ministry of Earth Sciences released the 'National Report on Deep-Sea and Distant-Water Fishery Resources of the Indian EEZ.' The report synthesises nearly four decades of oceanographic research and over 400 research cruises since the early 1990s, largely aboard the FORV Sagar Sampada, covering India's 2.37 million sq km Exclusive Economic Zone. It assesses underexploited deep-sea and distant-water fishery resources (mesopelagic species, deep-sea demersal stocks, tunas, billfishes, Antarctic krill), identifies key marine biodiversity hotspots, and proposes a technology-driven roadmap using AI, eDNA and acoustics for marine spatial planning under India's Blue Economy vision.

title: Global Digital Capacity Building Alliance: Building a Global Platform for State Capability

ministry.name: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions

summary: The Global Digital Capacity Building Alliance (GDCBA), launched by India's Capacity Building Commission on 20 February 2026 at the India AI Impact Summit, has completed six months. It has grown to include engagement across 10 countries with over 250 public officials and institutional partners such as the World Bank, Gates Foundation, UNICEF and the Commonwealth, and plans an annual Summit and a State of Capacity Building Report going forward.

title: CSIR-CRRI and CSIR-AMPRI Organise Workshop on Innovative Materials and Advanced Composites for Sustainable Infrastructure
summary: CSIR-CRRI and CSIR-AMPRI jointly organised a one-day workshop on 'Innovative Materials and Advanced Composites for Sustainable Infrastructure' at Bhopal as part of CSIR-CRRI's Platinum Jubilee Celebrations (July 2026-July 2027). About 300 delegates from bodies like MP PWD, NHAI and MPRDC, along with academia and industry, attended sessions on construction and rehabilitation technologies, sustainable materials/recycling, and advanced composites for infrastructure.

title: ICF, RCF and MCF to Start Manufacturing 238 AC EMU Rakes for Mumbai Suburban Railway to Ensure Timely Availability
summary: The Railway Board has sanctioned manufacturing of 238 AC EMU rakes for Mumbai suburban railway through its three Production Units — Integral Coach Factory (ICF) Chennai (120 rakes), Rail Coach Factory (RCF) Kapurthala (71 rakes), and Modern Coach Factory (MCF) Raebareli (47 rakes). This is aimed at ensuring timely rolling stock availability to match infrastructure being commissioned under the Mumbai Urban Transport Project (MUTP). Supply is planned to begin in 2027, with full completion of the order by 2030.

title: Newly Reconstituted National Commission for Minorities Holds First Meeting of 2026, Reviews Welfare and Safeguards for Minority Communities
summary: The reconstituted National Commission for Minorities (NCM), chaired by Shri Harjit Singh Grewal, held its first meeting of 2026, attended by the Vice Chairperson and Members along with the Secretary and Joint Secretary. The Commission reviewed welfare matters concerning minority communities and discussed pending issues and the way forward. The Chairperson reiterated NCM's mandate to promote minority development and monitor safeguards protecting their interests.

title: Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah chairs 31st meeting of the Southern Zonal Council in Mahabalipuram, Tamil Nadu
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired the 31st Southern Zonal Council meeting in Mahabalipuram, Tamil Nadu, attended by chief ministers/administrators of Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar, Lakshadweep and Telangana. He said 70 Zonal Council meetings since 2014 have resolved about 80% (1,445 of 1,869) of pending issues, cited resolution of North India's river-water disputes as a model, and urged southern states to resolve pending water disputes and the Andhra Pradesh-Telangana asset/liability division through dialogue with the Centre. He also raised interlinking of rivers, Fast Track Special Courts for POCSO cases, reducing school dropout ratio below 3%, tackling malnutrition/stunting, and a three-year roadmap for a drug-free India.

title: DFS Organises Workshop to Strengthen Implementation of Reservation Policy Across Public Financial Institutions
summary: The Department of Financial Services organised a two-day workshop (20-21 August 2026) at Union Bank of India Staff College, Bengaluru, on implementing the Government of India's Reservation Policy across Public Sector Banks, Insurance Companies, regulators and financial institutions. Over 100 senior HR functionaries and Chief Liaison Officers from RBI, PFRDA, IRDAI, 12 PSBs, 7 PSICs and 7 PFIs attended, with Day 2 focusing on improving financial service accessibility for Divyangjans.

title: DDWS Organises National Workshop on Multi-Stakeholder Consultation for Capacity Building under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0
summary: The Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation held a National Workshop on multi-stakeholder consultation for capacity building under Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) 2.0, bringing together States/UTs, WASH partners and training institutions to review eight training modules for Gram Panchayats, Village Water and Sanitation Committees (VWSCs) and Sujalam Shakti Groups. Officials including the NJJM Mission Director and Joint Secretary emphasised sustainability of rural water services through community ownership, defined institutional roles, and digital monitoring tools. The workshop concluded with recommendations to refine the training modules for rollout under JJM 2.0.

title: DPIIT Signs MoUs with PhonePe and Shell India to Strengthen Startup Ecosystem and Drive Innovation
summary: DPIIT signed MoUs with PhonePe and Shell India on 19 August 2026 to support DPIIT-recognised startups. PhonePe will offer payment gateway credits, AppStore access, onboarding support and masterclasses, while Shell India will provide mentorship, investor connect and participation in its Smart Energy Track for energy and climate-tech startups, along with knowledge products like white papers and case studies.

title: BRICS 8th Ocean and Polar Science and Technology working group meeting
summary: The Ministry of Earth Sciences, through NCPOR, hosted the 8th BRICS Working Group on Ocean Polar Science and Technology (OPST) in Goa from 12-14 August 2026 during India's BRICS Presidency. Delegates from Brazil, China, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Russia, South Africa and the UAE discussed coastal resilience, strengthening the Global Ocean Observing System, joint polar research, and capacity building for young researchers. The meeting concluded with agreement on collaborative initiatives including coastal resilience building, joint polar ocean biodiversity studies, and milestones for International Polar Year-5.

title: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal Strengthens India-Singapore Economic Partnership through High-Level Bilateral and Business Engagements
summary: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal held a series of engagements in Singapore on 20 August 2026, including a call on PM Lawrence Wong, participation in the 4th India-Singapore Ministerial and Business Roundtables, an MoU signing, G2B meetings with firms like GFTN and Keppel Infrastructure, an APEDA-FairPrice agri-trade visit, and a FICCI-organised business forum at INSEAD. The visit aimed to deepen India-Singapore cooperation in trade, investment, technology and business linkages.

title: Ministry of Jal Shakti Releases Policy on Data Sharing, Interoperability and Stakeholder Access under Sujalam Bharat Digital Public Infrastructure
summary: The Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation (DDWS), Ministry of Jal Shakti, released a Policy on Data Sharing, Interoperability and Stakeholder Access under the Sujalam Bharat Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) on 20 August 2026. The policy creates a secure, federated and interoperable framework for sharing rural drinking water data among the Centre, States/UTs, Gram Panchayats and approved sectoral stakeholders, using common identifiers, standardised metadata and interoperable registries. It incorporates tiered, purpose-based data access along with privacy, cybersecurity and public-interest safeguards to support Panchayat-centric governance, citizen accountability and AI/geospatial-enabled service delivery in the rural water sector.

title: PROVISIONAL ESTIMATES OF INDEX OF CORE INDUSTRIES FOR THE MONTH OF JULY 2026, AND FINAL INDEX FOR THE MONTH OF JUNE 2026 WITH BASE YEAR 2022-23
summary: The Index of Core Industries (ICI) grew 5.4% year-on-year in July 2026 (provisional), slower than the revised 6.0% growth in June 2026.
